# Fixes

- Added compatibility builds for Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 and **26.3**, updating release coverage beyond 1.21.10.
- Updated the 26.x build pipeline to use Java 25 and Paper's build-qualified Maven API instead of the older Spigot API coordinate scheme.
- Corrected per-version `plugin.yml` API declarations and extended validation so published JARs match the intended Minecraft version.

# Changelog

**Added**
- Four Minecraft-version JARs and matching setup ZIPs, bringing release coverage to **14 supported build targets**.
- Java 25 / Paper 26.x compatibility checks, including Towny's 26.3-compatible `0.103.2.15` pre-release.
- Additional test-plan coverage for 26.x startup, role synchronization, and DiscordSRV linking.

**Modified**
- Updated the README compatibility matrix, supported Java versions, dependency guidance, and download instructions.
- Removed outdated descriptions of unreleased development build variants from the public documentation.
- Improved consistency checks between CI, plugin metadata, release assets and Markdown guides.

# Compatibility

| Minecraft | Server | Towny compile API | DiscordSRV |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2 | Spigot / Paper / Purpur | 0.100.3.0 | 1.30.5 |
| 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.6 | Paper / Purpur | 0.103.2.0 | 1.30.5 |
| 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.8, 1.21.10, 1.21.11 | Paper / Purpur | 0.103.2.0 | 1.30.5 |
| 26.1.2, 26.2 | Paper / Purpur, Java 25 | 0.103.2.0 | 1.30.5 |
| 26.3 | Paper / Purpur, Java 25 | 0.103.2.15 (pre-release) | 1.30.5 |

Minecraft 26.1.0 has no Paper build, and 26.1.1 is not included because only obsolete alpha Paper builds were available. Folia is not supported.

# Downloads and upgrade notes

Choose the **JAR matching your Minecraft version**. The corresponding optional ZIP includes `config.example.yml`, README, migration instructions and `BUILD-INFO.txt`.

This is a pre-release: automated compilation and storage testing are not a substitute for real Discord guild/Paper-Purpur integration testing. Back up `plugins/TownyDiscordChat/`, your database, and important Discord guild settings before deployment.

There are no intentional changes to stored database schemas in 1.1.1. Existing 1.1.0 configuration settings remain compatible; leave `config.yml` in place when upgrading from 1.1.0. When upgrading from an older 1.0.x installation, follow the documented `config.yml.bak` migration and two-start review process. SQLite-to-MySQL migration remains a separate opt-in operation.
